recordedOnly.note: Re-measured from scratch after the instrument moved off the deleted Planning screen and onto Inventory. Everything below is a NEW baseline against a different screen and a different fixture (account-offline: 13 heroes, 221 items) — it is not comparable to the figures this file carried before, and nothing here is a regression against them. A quiet window still costs ZERO, unchanged and for the same reason: the fixture ticker's ~100 commits per 5s all carry an identical body, so no account:changed is emitted at all. The one-item change is dropping a single gear item, which costs 17206 component renders across 8 commits and touches 95 distinct component types — two orders of magnitude above what the old two-hero Planning roster cost, because the grid re-renders all ~220 cards and their per-card subtrees for a change to one of them. That is a real, pre-existing property of the grid this instrument now makes visible; it is not something this move introduced. Three consecutive local runs from one build produced 0/17206/95 every time, byte-identical. The ranges keep a margin for a slower CI machine rather than pinning exact values.
